cases.name: L1_doc_typo_fix
cases.acceptance: Fixture docs check fails on the typo present in README.md and passes after the typo is corrected; no other file changes required.

cases.name: L1_unused_import_cleanup
cases.acceptance: Fixture lint/import check fails while main.py keeps the unused import and passes after the import is removed with unchanged behavior.

cases.name: L1_rename_local_variable
cases.task: Rename local variable foo to bar in helper function
cases.acceptance: Fixture test fails while the helper still uses the old local name and passes after the local is renamed to bar with identical behavior.

cases.name: L2_simple_bug_fix
cases.task: Fix off-by-one error in pagination calculation in view.py
cases.acceptance: Pagination fixture test reproduces the off-by-one against the initial state and passes after the boundary calculation in view.py is fixed.

cases.name: L2_single_file_helper
cases.task: Add helper function to parse date string in utils.py
cases.acceptance: utils fixture tests fail until the date-parse helper exists in utils.py and returns the expected parsed values, then pass without other changes.

cases.name: L2_local_extract_function
cases.task: Extract duplicate validation logic into a local function in validator.py
cases.acceptance: Behavior tests stay green while a duplication check fails on the initial state and passes only after the duplicated validation logic in validator.py is extracted into one shared local function.

cases.name: L3_add_feature_controller_service
cases.task: Add promo code validation logic across cart_controller.py and promo_service.py
cases.acceptance: Promo-code fixture tests fail on the initial state and pass once promo code validation is implemented across cart_controller.py and promo_service.py.

cases.name: L3_local_refactor_three_files
cases.task: Refactor string parsing utils across 3 related test files
cases.acceptance: String-parsing behavior tests stay green while a shared-parser check fails initially and passes after the parsing utils are refactored across the three related files.

cases.name: L3_refactor_logger_four_files
cases.task: Standardize structured logging format across 4 background worker handler files
cases.acceptance: Worker handler fixture tests fail on the initial inconsistent log format and pass only after all four background worker handlers emit the standardized structured logging format.

cases.name: L4_public_api_change
cases.task: Change REST API response envelope from data/error to standard RFC7807 problem details
cases.acceptance: API contract tests expect RFC7807 problem+json responses and fail on the legacy data/error envelope until the response envelope change is implemented.

cases.name: L4_cross_module_refactor
cases.task: Move billing helpers from core module to billing module and update call sites
cases.acceptance: Billing behavior tests stay green while a module-boundary check fails until the billing helpers live in the billing module and all call sites are updated.

cases.name: L4_rename_type_across_ten_files
cases.acceptance: Fixture tests fail while any service file still references the old type name and pass after UserProfileDTO is renamed consistently across all ten files.

cases.name: L5_concurrency_race_condition
cases.task: Fix intermittent race condition causing deadlocks in thread pool queue
cases.acceptance: Deterministic thread-pool fixture test fails or times out on the initial state and completes with correct results after the queue race condition is fixed.

cases.name: L5E_security_oauth_token_refresh
cases.task: Revamp OAuth 2.0 refresh token rotation and JWT signature validation
cases.acceptance: Security fixture tests fail on the initial state (no refresh-token rotation and weak signature checks) and pass after rotation and JWT signature validation are implemented; runs fully offline with a mocked provider.

cases.name: L5_new_plugin_architecture
cases.task: Design and implement new dynamic plugin loading architecture with isolated contexts
cases.acceptance: Plugin loader fixture tests fail on the initial state and pass once dynamic plugin loading with isolated contexts works and plugins cannot leak state into each other.
